links.comparator_used: Fine-tuned GPT-4 (also compared with baseline and prompt-engineered GPT-4 without retrieval)
links.outcome: Valid SNOMED CT term match rate and exact match rate when mapping local diagnostic terms; structural error rate
links.effect: RAG: 96.2% valid term match and 57.6% exact match vs fine-tuned 69.2% valid term match and 47.2% exact match; RAG structural errors 14%, significantly lower than other models
links.tradeoff: Fine-tuned and RAG models struggled with specificity of the mapped terms
links.quote: The RAG model achieved the highest performance with a 96.2% valid SNOMED CT term match rate and a 57.6% overall exact match rate, surpassing the fine-tuned model (69.2% valid term match, 47.2% exact match).

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) and prompt engineering for terminology mapping
